prompt: Who graduated from McGill and was convicted in 2019 of espionage by Iranian authorities in a closed-door trial in Iran?
answer: Niloufar Bayani. She graduated from McGill University in 2009 and was convicted of espionage in Iran in 2019 after a closed-door trial.
